verdict.rationale: Highnote supports rule-based automation through spend rules, velocity controls, and collaborative authorization that evaluate logic (MCC, amount, count, time boundaries) at authorization time and trigger allow/decline actions automatically, plus webhooks for event notifications. However, this is narrowly scoped to payment/card authorization events rather than a general-purpose 'if event X then action Y' automation engine across arbitrary triggers. missing for 10: evidence of a general rules/automation engine beyond spend/velocity controls, ability to trigger arbitrary custom actions (not just approve/decline) on arbitrary events, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
